calls.statement:
SELECT 'store' k, store_key::VARCHAR a, store_id::VARCHAR b, store_name c, city d, valid_from::VARCHAR e, valid_to::VARCHAR f, is_current::VARCHAR g FROM dim_store WHERE store_name ILIKE '%Palokka%' OR city ILIKE '%Jyv%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'product', product_key::VARCHAR, sku::VARCHAR, product_name, category, valid_from::VARCHAR, valid_to::VARCHAR, is_current::VARCHAR||' delisted='||coalesce(delisted_on::VARCHAR,'null') FROM dim_product WHERE sku=100011
UNION ALL
SELECT 'date', calendar_date::VARCHAR, day_name, fiscal_year, fiscal_week::VARCHAR, fiscal_week_start_date::VARCHAR, fiscal_week_end_date::VARCHAR, fiscal_period_label FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-09'

SELECT s.week_ending_date, s.store_key, s.product_key, s.closing_units, s.closing_value, s.receipts_units, s.adjustment_units, s.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_stock_week s
WHERE s.store_key IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store WHERE store_id=124)
  AND s.product_key IN (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product WHERE sku=100011)
  AND s.week_ending_date >= DATE '2026-08-30'
ORDER BY s.week_ending_date, s.etl_loaded_at

SELECT 'fact' src, max(week_ending_date)::VARCHAR a, count(*)::VARCHAR b, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key, week_ending_date))::VARCHAR c, max(etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR d FROM fact_stock_week
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stg', max(week_ending_date)::VARCHAR, count(*)::VARCHAR, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key, week_ending_date))::VARCHAR, max(etl_loaded_at)::VARCHAR FROM stg_stock_snapshot
UNION ALL
SELECT 'fiscal', fiscal_period_label, fully_loaded::VARCHAR, period_start_date::VARCHAR, period_end_date::VARCHAR FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period IN (5,6)

SELECT 'stg' k, week_ending_date::VARCHAR a, closing_units::VARCHAR b, receipts_units::VARCHAR c, adjustment_units::VARCHAR d FROM stg_stock_snapshot WHERE store_key=30 AND product_key=11 AND week_ending_date>=DATE '2026-09-20'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sales', sale_date::VARCHAR, sum(quantity)::VARCHAR, count(*)::VARCHAR, '' FROM fact_sales_line WHERE store_key=30 AND product_key=11 AND sale_date>=DATE '2026-09-14' GROUP BY sale_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', return_date::VARCHAR, sum(quantity_returned)::VARCHAR, count(*)::VARCHAR, '' FROM fact_return_line WHERE store_key=30 AND product_key=11 AND return_date>=DATE '2026-09-14' GROUP BY return_date
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closure', closure_type, closure_start_date::VARCHAR, closure_end_date::VARCHAR, weeks_closed::VARCHAR FROM ref_store_closure WHERE store_id=124
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, st.store_id, st.store_name, s.week_ending_date, s.closing_units
FROM fact_stock_week s
JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_key = s.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = s.product_key
WHERE st.store_id = 124 AND p.sku = 100011 AND s.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-10-04'
